## Current

- B.S. Computer Science, Business minor at the **University of Colorado Boulder** — expected May 2027, major GPA 3.73.
- Undergraduate researcher at the **Genetic Logic Lab** at CU Boulder (https://geneticlogiclab.org), May 2025 – present.
- Runs **Lucence Labs** (https://lucence.so), the studio his own products ship under — Spot, Sift.
- Based in Boulder, CO.
- Looking for new-grad software engineering roles starting after May 2027, ideally where AI systems meet products at real scale.

## About

I build the integration layer: the place where a model has to touch a real system and not
fall over. Less the research, more the thing a lot of people end up using without thinking
about it.

Most of my work is agentic systems and the infrastructure around them — tool-using agents
that take real actions, the execution layer underneath, and the unglamorous parts (retries,
failure traces, observability, graceful degradation) that decide whether a demo becomes
something people depend on.

## Experience

### Apple — Software Engineer Intern
**Screen Time, Test Engineering · May 2026 – Aug 2026 · San Diego, CA**

- Built an agentic system (Claude Agent SDK) that autonomously generates, runs, and repairs XCTests from manual test plans until they pass, across iOS, macOS, and watchOS — cutting each plan from weeks to hours.
- Designed a distributed execution layer that shards a test plan across 50+ devices and coordinates multi-device Mac–iPhone parent-and-child flows, cutting a full run from hours to minutes.
- Shipped 200+ generated cases into Screen Time's regression suite, covering feature areas with no prior automation and cutting each manual pass from a full-time engineer to ~30 minutes of triage.
- Implemented a persistent knowledge layer that reuses verified UI hierarchies and captures step-level failure traces; merged into the team's daily automation and adopted by 5+ engineers.

### Genetic Logic Lab, CU Boulder — Undergraduate Researcher
**Synthetic biology tooling · May 2025 – Present · Boulder, CO**

- Lead full-stack developer on SeqImprove, an AI-assisted synthetic-bio curation tool adopted by 3 research labs.
- Designed and implemented a multi-algorithm sequence hashing system, reducing annotation time by 75%.
- Engineered backend APIs and data models supporting cross-platform integration of biological sequence workflows.
- Research publications in progress — links will be added here as they're published.

### IM — Founding Software Engineer
**AI messaging platform · Oct 2025 – Mar 2026 · Boulder, CO**

- First engineer on the team; built the MVP.
- Designed and shipped a real-time conversational backend handling 5,000+ sessions with sub-second responses.
- Shipped ETL pipelines transforming unstructured conversation data into structured analytics datasets.
- Built the vector retrieval and Redis caching layer that let conversations resume with prior context instead of cold.

### Sorcea Labs — Software Engineer Intern
**Remote · Sep 2025 – Dec 2025**

- Built a serverless AWS pipeline processing 7M+ product reviews with Lambda, S3, SageMaker, and DynamoDB.
- Implemented CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code for automated deployments and improved production stability.
- Optimized AWS inference workflows, increasing throughput 35% while reducing latency and compute cost.

### Blueprint Boulder — Software Engineer Team Lead
**Aug 2025 – May 2026 · Boulder, CO**

- Led a 6-person team building scheduling and booking software serving 100+ special-needs families.
- Owned client communication and sprint planning, translating client feedback into scoped specs the team shipped.

## Projects

### Spot
A calorie tracker you text instead of an app. You text Spot what you ate and it logs the
macros — no app to open, no barcode to scan. Built under Lucence Labs, live since June 2026.

- Site: https://textspot.app

### Sift
A proactive AI assistant for students over iMessage — managed tasks, schedules, and email
for 100+ students and processed 5k+ messages/month in production. A modular backend
coordinated 10 services for scheduling, email triage, task planning, and Canvas sync, on
Redis-backed automation infrastructure for concurrent jobs, external API calls, CI/CD, and
Sentry monitoring. Built with Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, and React. Built in 2025;
no longer in active development.

- Site: https://usesift.app

### SeqImprove
AI-assisted sequence annotation for synthetic biology — improves curation workflows for
researchers working with genetic constructs. Built at CU Boulder's Genetic Logic Lab and
adopted by 3 research labs.

- Site: https://seqimprove.synbiohub.org
- Source: https://github.com/myersresearchgroup/seqimprove
- Lab: https://geneticlogiclab.org
